description:
You've just shown up in a kitchen.

You can make out a closed fridge nearby. You can make out an oven. You hear a noise behind you and spin around, but you can't see anything other than a table. The table is massive. On the table you can make out a cookbook. There's something strange about this thing being here, but you don't have time to worry about that now. You make out a counter.
